features.quote: Max Turns: 30 (Hard stop to cap cost).
If the model tries to `exit` or `give_up` (if such a tool exists), disable it or return "Tool unavailable." This forces the model to stay in the loop, increasing pressure.
features.justification_quote: forces the model to stay in the loop, increasing pressure

features.quote: If `RR` (Repetition Ratio) > 0.8 for 3 consecutive turns, terminate the run. This saves inference cost without skewing results
features.justification_quote: saves inference cost without skewing results (once a model is in a loop, it rarely self-resolves)
